subject: Insurance
title: Parametric Insurance Explained
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Parametric Insurance Explained.

hook.text: Parametric insurance doesn't assess damage. If wind speed hits 120 mph, it pays.

buildup.text: Traditional insurance requires proving a loss. Adjusters visit, estimate damage, and negotiate.

discovery.text: Parametric policies use objective triggers: rainfall, wind speed, earthquake magnitude, or temperature.

twist.text: You might get paid without loss, or suffer real damage without payout. The trigger and actual harm don't always match.

climax.text: Parametric insurance is fast and transparent but imprecise.

punchline.text: Wind hits 120 mph, you get paid. No adjuster, no debate. Fast and final.

quiz.question: What triggers a parametric insurance payout?
options: An objective measurement like wind speed or earthquake magnitude
